g.text: CL-Bench | Memory payload carried across tasks | R=1
Native: memory-file payload. Pi: canonicalized persisted-state payload; feedback stored separately.
Different representations, not a storage-efficiency ranking. Dotted lines mark database migration / repository switch.
File presence does not establish model visibility or causal benefit. Hermes Codebase includes one unscored interrupted task.
